name: Burn Bar
author: nixfred
description: Live thermal heat map of Claude, Codex and local Ollama burn in one bar slot, with weekly quota gauges, local model control, and the share of tokens kept off frontier models.

barWidget.description: Token spend as a heat map — Claude burns left, Codex right, newest at the centre, and a live local-inference lane on the far right.

schema.label: History window (minutes)
schema.description: How far back the cloud lanes reach. 360 = six hours.

schema.label: Plan-limit refresh (seconds)
schema.description: How often Burn Bar asks Omarchy's own usage collectors for fresh Claude and Codex plan limits.

schema.label: Show local intelligence lane
schema.description: Live Ollama runner load on the right of the strip.

schema.label: Local inference threshold (%)
schema.description: Runner load above this counts as actively inferencing.

schema.label: Ollama systemd unit
schema.description: Whose journal carries the runner's token lines. Local token counts and the offload share come from there.

schema.label: Ember flicker
schema.description: Live flicker on hot cells. Turn off to save a little GPU.

schema.label: Rising sparks
schema.description: Embers lifting off the strip while anything is burning.
